meta.name: twitter-thread-writer
meta.description: Write X/Twitter threads that get bookmarked, shared, and drive affiliate clicks. Use this skill when the user asks about writing Twitter threads, X threads, tweet threads for affiliate marketing, or says "write a thread about X", "Twitter thread promoting X", "X thread for affiliate", "write tweets that go viral", "thread that sells without selling", "educational thread with affiliate CTA", "Twitter content for affiliate marketing", "how to promote X on Twitter", "write a thread my audience will bookmark", "tweet storm about affiliate product".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 撰写高互动 X 线程推动联盟营销
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在 X 上推广产品并增加转化。
copy.tagline_en: Write engaging X threads to boost affiliate marketing.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to promote products on X and drive conversions.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你撰写 X/Twitter 推文串，用于推广联盟产品，自动生成钩子、正文和行动号召，并确保每条推文不超过 280 字符、包含 FTC 广告声明。
howto.when: 当你要求撰写推广联盟产品的推文串，或提到“write a thread about X”、“Twitter thread promoting X”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 写一条推广 ConvertKit 给自由职业者的推文串。

say.note: 采用 Contrarian Take 框架，自然推荐产品。

say.text: 为 HeyGen 视频工具写 8 条推文的教程。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you write X/Twitter threads to promote affiliate products. It auto-generates hooks, body tweets, and CTAs, ensuring each tweet is under 280 characters and includes FTC #ad disclosure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write an X/Twitter thread promoting an affiliate product, or mention phrases like "write a thread about X", "Twitter thread promoting X", etc.

Write a contrarian thread about email marketing tools.
